text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl who will carve her name into history as the "strongest." 
As her trainer, I set down my hoofprints here--

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Duramente. 
Born into a family of world-class athletes, 
heir to their talent--a "crystal of that blood."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
At the Twinkle Series debut press conference, 
she declared her goal was to become the "strongest." 
And she announced she would win the Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
But there was an unfinished side to her. 
When the crowd responded to her declaration with excitement, 
she began trembling with nerves.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Supporting her through that is my role too-- 
Once she had steadied herself, she announced 
she would first take the Classic Triple Crown route.
